codcaster/3rd_person_camera_follow_mode_:
Set the default 3rd Person Camera Mode.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Orbital^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^: The camera is tethered at a specific distance from the operator and the Codcaster is able to move the camera around them.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Fixed^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^: The camera remains behind the spectated player's operator.

codcaster/aerial_camera_default_desc:
Set the default Aerial Camera Mode.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Free^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^: The observer fully controls the Aerial Camera's position.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Follow^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^: The camera is tethered to the spectated player and the observer can offset the camera position around this player.

Note:^?#x08e606b1af56d8ac2.#x070743ccf32890e6c^ Use shortcuts at any time during match to switch between modes.
codcaster/aerial_camera_movement_smoothi:

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Low Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^High Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.

hash_1c240b9806656fd1: Unlock War Tracks by earning them in the Battle Pass or purchasing them in the Store.

hash_1062eac4bd598582: Score-based game mode with respawns where the goal is to kill the other team more than they kill you.
hash_1062e9c4bd5983cf: During the fight the top player on each team is marked as a High Value Target. This H.V.T. is worth extra score when killed.
hash_1062e8c4bd59821c: Kill the enemy team and focus on taking down their H.V.T. for extra score. If you find yourself the H.V.T. do your best to stick with your teammates and survive!

hash_371c1b44d6e1caed: Play like the pros while still earning XP, unlocking content, and completing challenges!

hash_371c1944d6e1c787: In the Call of Duty League\xe2\x84\xa2 playlists, your Private Match Loadouts are used and all items are unlocked. Restricted items will be replaced.

hash_64d197184db99648: Choose where your squad will infil in the DMZ.
hash_64d19a184db99b61: Only bring what you need. When you die in the DMZ you lose all gear and loot.
hash_64d199184db999ae: Loot, complete missions, and get to the chopper to secure your haul.
hash_5dd3488685dec64f: Extract and eliminate key objectives to unlock upgrades like decreased weapon cooldown times and buy station upgrades.
hash_5dd3498685dec802: Full reset of your missions. Introducing Faction Reputation and Urgent missions.
hash_5dd34a8685dec9b5: A new exclusion zone has been added to deployment. Drop in and explore its new POIs.
hash_19fa52abd3fed7d1: Introducing Shadow Company. All new faction, all new missions.
hash_19fa4fabd3fed2b8: Disguise, Battle Revive, Scuba Gas Mask, MRAP & more. Add them to your equipment arsenal.
hash_19fa50abd3fed46b: Konni invades all of DMZ and fights for total control. Shadow Company is now on your side. It's an all out war!
hash_2955407a0155de47: Edit Loadout allows you to configure loadouts that can be accessed during the match. Assemble battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, and Perks.
hash_2955417a0155dffa: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your loadout. Perks give your soldier abilities on the battlefield.
hash_2955427a0155e1ad: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionalities.
hash_1d1b0898f1aff160: Officer Ranks are a new seasonal leveling system for Call of Duty\xc2\xae: Black Ops 7. Once you have completed the Enlisted Ranks, you may climb the Officer Ranks to earn recognition and rewards.
hash_1d1b0b98f1aff679: Each new Officer Rank unlocks a challenge which can be completed for a medal ribbon and an XP boost. The more Rank Challenges you complete, the more ribbons you earn and the faster you progress.
hash_1d1b0a98f1aff4c6: Officer Ranks are specific to the current Season. Climb as high as possible during the current season to maximize your Rank. Remember - Officer Ranks are reset at the start of each new Season, but your achievements will be saved to build your history as a combatant.
hash_f55031b5562dd2c: Field Upgrades are abilities and pieces of gear that can give you a tactical edge in battle.
hash_f55061b5562e245: They recharge throughout a fight. More powerful Field Upgrades take longer to charge.
hash_f55051b5562e092: Field Upgrade Pro lets you equip two Field Upgrades instead of one. Choose between them on each activation. Unlocked at level 45.
hash_283b838dbc4b4010: Field upgrade pro is now available. You can now equip 2 field upgrades instead of 1. Choose between them on each activation.
hash_5790d14ae16813e: Or, first team to reach score limit wins
hash_68a488ee01aa2ba5: Gunsmith is a deep weapon customization system that allows you to create your own custom firearms.
hash_68a485ee01aa268c: Leveling up your weapons in battle will unlock new attachments across 8 attachment zones, as well as weapon perks.
hash_68a486ee01aa283f: Upgrade your weapon with up to 5 attachments that significantly change how your weapon feels. Experiment with various combinations to suit your playstyle and different game modes.
hash_7427fb261d136caa: When selecting attachments, hit the Blueprint button to select from the attachment variants you own!
hash_7427fa261d136af7: Combine cosmetic attachment variants from up to 5 weapons to create the weapon that's right for you!
hash_486d28a9225c0244: New Intel Missions are available to play in Warzone. Find more information in the Missions menu on the Intel tab.
hash_486d2ba9225c075d: Intel Missions give you a variety of scavenger based missions to do when dropping into the Warzone.
hash_486d2aa9225c05aa: Completing the Intel Missions will give you the chance to follow Ghost and learn more about Verdansk.
hash_2ef150e3933a297a: Killstreaks are powerful support packages that you can call into the battlefield during a match. Used properly, they can turn the tide of a fight.
hash_2ef14fe3933a27c7: Earn Killstreaks by getting Kills without dying. Each type of Killstreak requires a specific number of Kills to earn. The more Kills one costs, the more powerful it is. You may choose three Killstreaks as part of your combat readiness.
hash_2ef14ee3933a2614: When you're in combat, you may trigger each Killstreak once you've achieved the corresponding number of Kills. Be sure to keep an eye on the Killstreak HUD to see what you have available.
hash_4b74d6d760a38b97: Each round the location of the package is randomized. Move in and attempt to secure.
hash_4b74d7d760a38d4a: Eliminate the other enemy team or be holding the package when the round is over to win the round.
hash_4b74d8d760a38efd: Downed teammates can be revived one time. First team to hit the round score limit wins!
hash_49fb73b3fda108ac: Edit loadout allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and Field Upgrades.
hash_7d97b6530fa409ca: Create A Class allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Munitions, and Roles.
hash_49fb76b3fda10dc5: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your loadout. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Killstreaks and Field Upgrades allow you to call in support mid-match.
hash_3bb6869e4621245: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your class. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Munitions and Roles allow you provide support to your team.
hash_49fb75b3fda10c12: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionality. You can set your favorite loadout to see it on the gun bench and in the hands of your Operator in the menus.
hash_434d6489787e6f75: Work your way through different skill-based challenges to unlock unique mastery calling cards.
hash_66ca3d1d4aaabdf2: Player discretion is advised. Some scenes include graphic or intense content including violence. Please consult the game\xe2\x80\x99s ratings.
hash_4804058ed4e186d1:
Represent your country with new Mil-Sim operators for both Coalition and Allegiance factions. Mil-Sim Operators can be purchased in
bundles from the ^5Store ^7or unlocked via the ^5Battle Pass^7.
hash_53bca62596fd497d: Missions are multi-step challenges that can be completed for XP bonuses and special rewards.
hash_53bca32596fd4464: Missions must be activated in order to complete them. Activate a Mission from the Missions page and track your progress. You will be notified when you complete each step and when you have completed your overall objectives.
hash_53bca42596fd4617: There are several Missions available, with more to be released in each new season. Be sure to check back to the Missions page for new challenges and rewards.
hash_3718193cde06e18: Custom Mods are weapons that you create, customize, and save into your Armory. Mod slots are unlocked by leveling each weapon.
hash_3718493cde07331: Create a Custom Mod in Gunsmith by adding attachments, customizing with camos and charms, and then saving it into one of your Mod Slots. You can personalize its name to make it stand out.
hash_3718393cde0717e: Custom Mods track stats, so your weapon will build a history. As long as your Mod retains the same base weapon and name, you may continue to modify it.
hash_70acb2d5523f8e20: For a limited time, hop into Modern Warfare's multiplayer mode to rank up, level your guns and complete challenges.
hash_70acb5d5523f9339: A wide variety of Maps and Game-modes are live in the Multiplayer Trial playlist.
hash_70acb4d5523f9186: If you upgrade you can choose what you want to play, when you want to play it. A deep and mature Campaign, a fun action Packed 4 Player Co-Op Experience and a Variety filled Multiplayer complete with 2v2 Gunfight, Night Vision, Realism, Objective Modes, 64 Player Ground War battles and much much more!
hash_4bb31163199be0ed: Munitions can be equipped before going in game by spending points won by playing the game.
hash_4bb30e63199bdbd4: Munitions found during a mission are not kept afterwards.
hash_4bb30f63199bdd87: Activate munitions using the radial menu. Points will be spent when they are used.
hash_658f2ddde605a640: Acquisitions are single use items with powerful effects. Exfil with Acquisitions to save them in your Acquisition Stash.
hash_658f30dde605ab59: Schematics are valuable plans that permanently allow you to craft Acquisitions, with a cooldown after use.
hash_1cd1442a1d8d3d2c: Complete contracts and exfil to raise your Containment Level for your operator.
hash_1cd1472a1d8d4245: Increases your Containment Level to start each Deployment with bonuses that give you an extra advantage on the battlefield.
hash_5e2db70c337c063: Take your favorite weapon you\xe2\x80\x99ve unlocked via an Insured Slot. If you lose an Insured Weapon, it will go on cooldown.
hash_5e2dc70c337c216: Exfil with weapons to add them to your Contraband Stash. Contraband Weapons are not Insured and will be permanently lost if left behind.
hash_313ce5bb98915d7f: Survive during the Resurgence countdown to redeploy your allies to the Warzone. Earn points to shorten the countdown.
hash_313ce6bb98915f32: Heads up! Resurgence supply boxes can be reopened shortly after use.
hash_313ce7bb989160e5: Getting a kill highlights the victim's allies positions for a brief period in your mini-map.
hash_559378824f5e88e6: Operator Missions have been moved from the Missions screen to the Operators screen.
hash_559377824f5e8733: You no longer need to manually select Operator Missions \xe2\x80\x93 if an Operator has an available Mission, it will be active automatically when you have that Operator selected.
hash_559376824f5e8580: Core Missions are still available to select from the Missions screen. Make sure to complete your Missions and maximize your XP.
hash_14c82bfa4b1c2558: Passive bonuses can be mixed and matched to fit your playstyle. Use them to boost your strengths or cover your weaknesses.
hash_14c82efa4b1c2a71: Enable Specialist for a loadout to earn perks instead of killstreaks. After 8 kills, become the ultimate soldier. Unlocked at level 29.
hash_14c82dfa4b1c28be: Retrieving a loadout from your Dropkit will equip your Perks. Plan ahead and choose perks that will give you an edge in Warzone.
hash_11e1567c49d1f97c: Perks have been adjusted to help create more balanced choices. Weak and unpopular perks have been buffed! Read the notes in the perk descriptions to find out more about what has changed for each perk.
hash_11e1597c49d1fe95: ^5Overkill ^7is now a red slot perk and must be picked against some of the strongest perks in the game. Combine it with scavenger to keep yourself fully loaded for any situation.
hash_11e1587c49d1fce2: ^5Kill Chain ^7has been moved to the blue slot. Combine it with Hardline or Pointman for a super charged killstreak loadout.
hash_5956fd1f63baf484: Round based mode where attackers must locate and exfil Prisoners being held by the defending team.
hash_5957001f63baf99d: Secured Prisoners must be carried to extraction. Teammates who are downed can be revived one time. Carrying a prisoner provides a radar sweep to the team.
hash_5956ff1f63baf7ea: Eliminating the enemy team is 50 points and every prisoner extracted or held at round end is worth 100 points. First team to 500 points wins!
hash_5d93a0ff571785bc: A Role is defined by the combination of an activated ability and a passive ability.
hash_5d93a3ff57178ad5: Choose a Role for your desired play style.
hash_5d93a2ff57178922: A team with players in different Roles is equipped to handle any situation.
hash_4ccdcf97dc0892a3: At level 29 the specialist mode becomes available. When activated you can have up to 6 perks in your loadout. You earn an extra perk every 2 kills. After 8 kills you earn the Specialist bonus which grants most perks and weapon perks in the game.

SAT_WEAPON/SAT_AR_CONDOR_DESC: Full-auto assault rifle. Exceptional mobility and handling, but high recoil and limited range.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_AR_EAGLE_DESC: Full-auto assault rifle. Excellent accuracy and range, offset by its slower mobility and rate of fire.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_AR_HAWK_DESC: Full-auto assault rifle. Well-rounded in its power, accuracy, and handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_DM_SCOTIA_DESC: 4-round burst marksman rifle. Extreme rate of fire within the burst, balanced by moderate burst cooldown.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_LA_POLIS_DESC: Charge launcher. Hold trigger to charge an energy beam that pierce enemies. Deals high damage to vehicles and scorestreaks.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_LM_HADES_DESC: Full-auto light machine gun. Great damage and high ammo count, limited by slower mobility and handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_ME_SHOCKBATON_DESC: Melee weapon. High damage and moderate attack speed.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_PI_ATLAS_DESC: Full-auto pistol. High damage and rate of fire, but high recoil and shorter effective ranges.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_PI_TIMIR_DESC: Semi-auto pistol. Reliable sidearm with a very fast rate of fire and low recoil.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SH_CORSO_DESC: Pump-action charge shotgun. Optionally hold trigger to improve hip and ADS spread.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SH_HUSKY_DESC: Rechambering double-barrel shotgun. Great range and high damage potential with back-to-back shots.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_KOMODO_DESC: Full-auto submachine gun. Extreme rate of fire, but limited range and slower handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_ORCA_DESC: Full-auto submachine gun. Solid balance of CQB power, handling, and recoil.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_ZEBRA_DESC: Full-auto submachine gun. Highly stable and effective at longer ranges, but with less raw CQB power.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SN_BALTIC_DESC: 3-round burst sniper rifle. High power and low recoil, but slower handling and short pre-fire delay. Hold [{+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SN_DRAKE_DESC: Bolt-action sniper rifle.  Quick rechamber. Moderate recoil and stability.  Hold [{+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
